title: Crash when submitting checkout form
body:
Users report checkout dies with a 500 as soon as they submit the form. Server log:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "api/routes_orders.py", line 6, in post_order
    order = place_order(request["customer_id"], request["items"])
  File "services/orders.py", line 8, in place_order
    order = Order.create({"customer_id": customer_id, "items": items})
  File "models/order.py", line 16, in create
    require_fields(payload, ["customer_id", "items"])
  File "core/validation.py", line 12, in require_fields
    if len(str(payload.get(f)).strip()) == 0:
TypeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip'

Happens maybe 1 in 20 checkouts, seems random.

title: Product names with emoji get silently truncated
body: We named a product "🚀 Rocket Mug" and after saving it shows up in the admin panel as "🚀 Rocket M" — looks broken and unprofessional in front of customers. No error, just wrong text.

title: Signup fails for international phone numbers
body: Trying to sign up with a UK mobile number like "+44 7911 123456" gets rejected with 'missing required fields: phone' even though I typed something in. US numbers work fine.

title: TypeError: expected str, got NoneType on order save
body:
Saw this in our error tracker, seems related to order creation:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "models/order.py", line 16, in create
    require_fields(payload, ["customer_id", "items"])
  File "core/validation.py", line 12, in require_fields
    if len(str(payload.get(f)).strip()) == 0:
TypeError: expected str instance, NoneType found

Only a handful of occurrences so far but growing.

title: CSV export skips rows with blank fields
body: When I export order history to CSV for accounting, some rows are just missing entirely — no error, they just aren't in the file. Happens for maybe 1 in 15 orders. Very annoying for reconciliation.

title: Price shows as 0.00 for sale items
body: Every item we put on sale shows a price of $0.00 in the storefront once the discount is applied. Looked into it a bit — seems like `product.price_cents` might be getting misread as an int somewhere in the discount math instead of the dollar float we use everywhere else.

title: Cart total doesn't match sum of items
body: Added 3 items to my cart, each shows a normal price on the product page, but the cart total at checkout is way off from what adding them by hand gives me. Not a rounding thing, off by a lot.

title: Inventory count goes negative after refunds
body: Processed a batch of refunds today and now several SKUs show negative stock in the dashboard, like -12 units. Support says it's confusing customers into thinking items are backordered. Looks like it's happening in `adjust_stock` whenever refunds and restocks overlap.

title: Image upload hangs on files over 5MB
body: If a customer uploads a product photo or avatar bigger than about 5MB, the upload endpoint just hangs forever — no error, no timeout, the browser spinner never stops. Have to kill the request.

title: Uploaded avatars appear rotated 90 degrees
body: Every avatar I upload from my phone (taken holding it sideways) ends up rotated 90 degrees in the profile page, even though it looks correct in my phone's photo gallery.

title: 🚨 URGENT — logging blew up my disk, EVERYTHING gone
body: THIS IS CRITICAL. THE LOG FILES FILLED UP MY ENTIRE DISK OVERNIGHT AND NOW THE SERVER WON'T EVEN BOOT. I HAD TO MANUALLY DELETE GIGABYTES OF LOG FILES JUST TO GET BACK ONLINE. THIS NEEDS TO BE FIXED IMMEDIATELY, WE COULD LOSE THE WHOLE BUSINESS OVER THIS.

title: CRITICAL!!! profile page completely broken!!!
body: THE PROFILE PAGE IS COMPLETELY BROKEN FOR ME RIGHT NOW!!! I CANNOT SEE ANYTHING ON MY ACCOUNT PAGE AT ALL!!! THIS IS THE WORST BUG I HAVE EVER SEEN IN THIS APP AND I NEED SOMEONE TO FIX IT TODAY.

title: This app is a disaster, nothing works
body: honestly nothing about this app works right, every time i try to do anything something breaks. fix your stuff.

title: Add a dark mode toggle
body: It would be great if there was a dark mode option in settings, staring at the white background at night is rough on the eyes. Not urgent, just a nice-to-have.

title: Typo in order confirmation message
body: Small thing, but the order confirmation message says 'has been recieved' — should be 'received'. Easy fix whenever someone has a spare minute.

title: Orders list takes 30s with 10k rows
body: The recent-orders admin view has gotten really slow now that we have ~10,000 orders in the system — takes close to 30 seconds to load and sometimes the request just times out. It was fine a few months ago when order volume was lower.

title: Admin dashboard 500s on bulk edit
body: Every time I try to do a bulk edit from the admin dashboard, `routes_admin` throws a 500 error and nothing gets saved. Happens consistently, not intermittent — 100% reproducible on our end.

title: Password reset email never arrives
body: I click 'forgot password', the app says an email was sent, but nothing ever shows up in my inbox — checked spam too. Tried three times over two days, still nothing. Locked out of my account.
